definitions.explanation: An academic rank at a university; a person who teaches at a university.
The act of teaching or instructing someone.

notes:
{教授|きょうじゅ} primarily means professor but can also mean teaching.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教授|きょうじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

SENSE 1 - PROFESSOR:
- {教授|きょうじゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a professor)
- 〜{教授|きょうじゅ} (Professor ~, as title)
- Full professor rank at university

ACADEMIC RANKS:
- ⟦{助教|じょきょう}→助教：27895_jokyou⟧ (assistant professor)
- ⟦{准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}→准教授：19861_junkyouju⟧ (associate professor)
- {教授|きょうじゅ} (full professor)
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{教授|きょうじゅ} (professor emeritus)

SENSE 2 - TEACHING:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教授|きょうじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to teach/instruct ~)
- More formal than ⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧

USAGE:
- As a title: 〜{教授|きょうじゅ} (Professor ~)
- Often abbreviated to {教授|きょうじゅ} when addressing
